recap.text: Genesis is a level ninety-five Lady Mantaur Dominator with black hair and a Kentucky accent. She uses arm chains to hook Niels the upgrade engineer through the face and drops his body at Carl's feet. Genesis drives a GTO on gold tyres out of a garage with an unconscious Corky in the back. She drives the car into a Gasworks factory through a trapped floor and is struck from the standings.

beats.headline: One of two womantaur dominators
beats.text: Subject is a Lady Mantaur Dominator, level ninety-five, and one of a pair driving for the Lady Dominators in the heats. She has black hair and a thick American accent that Carl places somewhere around Kentucky. Between the two of them she is the one who does the talking.
beats.gist: Driver is a level ninety-five Lady Mantaur Dominator with black hair and a Kentucky accent.

beats.headline: She hooks the engineer instead
beats.text: The arrangement was that the womantaurs fetch Crawler Carl a dead joey out of the boss's pouch with their arm chains. Genesis fires into the pouch and puts the grappling hook through the face of Niels, the upgrade engineer the boss had been keeping in there, killing him outright, and drops the body at Carl's feet. Asked why, she says she was not about to let him have the engineer. Neither engineer in the heat is claimed. Her partner adds that a temporary alliance does not make them stupid.
beats.gist: Genesis fires a grappling hook into the boss's pouch, kills Niels the engineer, and drops him.

beats.headline: They heard you coming
beats.text: For the record: the Lady Dominators were in their garage, and they were listening. As Crawler Carl's party prepared to cast a hole through the door, the door opened and the GTO rolled out for the starting line, Genesis driving on new tyres that appear to be made of gold, Corky unconscious in the back. A vehicle on its way to the start may not be attacked. Genesis invited Porky to hop in. Corky, she stated, is nontransferable. The party stepped off the driveway.
beats.gist: Genesis drives a GTO on gold tyres out of a garage while Corky lies unconscious.

beats.headline: Eliminated, with the gimp
beats.text: Heat Five results, final line: Eliminated, Lady Dominators and the Gimp. Genesis drove the GTO into the Gasworks factory on golden tyres and did not drive it out. The car went through a trapped floor, the containment failed, and the dolls were at it when Crawler Carl's party took Corky and left. The team is struck from the standings. The gimp, for the record, was no longer theirs by the finish, and would not have agreed that he ever was.
beats.gist: Genesis drove the GTO on golden tyres into the Gasworks factory and did not drive out.
